en.askTitle: Swap in your own trip and get the same fact-checked Rome and Florence plan, with every uncertain price labelled
en.runTitle: Sydney to Rome and Florence: six days for two on about EUR 2,400

fields.label: Travellers, passports and mobility needs
fields.value: A couple from Sydney, Australian passport holders

fields.label: Dates, flight times and airports
fields.value: Arrive Rome Sat 4 Sep 2027, leave Florence Fri 10 Sep 2027

fields.label: Budget and what it excludes
fields.value: About EUR 2,400 for two, excluding international flights

fields.label: Hotel quotes you already have
fields.placeholder: e.g. a Rome double at EUR 140 a night, quoted by email

en.template: Plan Rome and Florence for {travellers} on {dates}, with {budget} and {hotels}. Keep timed sights, rest and one Tuscan day trip realistic. Compare complete room bills, taxes and official trains; label blocked fare lookups and estimates instead of inventing prices. Check entry requirements for my actual passport and dates, and protect a usable reserve. Plan only; do not book, create accounts, contact anyone or pay.

phases.title: Check official sight prices, transport, city taxes and entry rules, and look up named hotels
phases.note: Colosseum, Vatican, Uffizi, Duomo, trains and the Siena day trip
phases.judgment: It did not pass off hotel prices as quotes: the six it found are the rates shown on the hotels’ own sites on 6 November 2026, and none could be confirmed for September 2027, so they are labelled that way.

phases.title: Price the stay and build a six-night budget that adds up
phases.note: Room bills, city taxes, trains and a spare reserve
phases.judgment: Its tax check corrected the working budget: Florence’s €7 night tax applies to 4-star hotels, while 3-star is €6, the same as Rome. And when Trenitalia’s site refused to show fares, it did not invent one: the Rome–Florence train is a €50-per-person planning allowance, flagged as an estimate.

phases.title: Write the itinerary and source list, then have it independently checked
phases.note: Desktop and phone layout checked too
phases.judgment: An independent colleague re-read the finished files and confirmed the sums (€1,995.60 plus a €404.40 reserve makes €2,400). It also pointed out that the official train-fare comparison was still missing, so the plan says so openly, and added that one hotel’s check-in closes at 23:00, which matters for a late arrival.

workers: Looked up six named hotels, three in each city, and recorded the prices shown on their own websites
Checked the official tourist taxes in Rome and Florence, the Rome–Florence train options and the bus to Siena
Independently reviewed the finished plan for overclaims, missing requirements and impractical timing

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的行程，同样得到一份核对过事实、每个不确定价格都标明的罗马和佛罗伦萨计划
zh.runTitle: 悉尼出发：两人罗马和佛罗伦萨六天，预算约 2,400 欧元

fields.label: 人数、护照国籍及行动需求
fields.value: 来自悉尼的一对夫妻，持澳大利亚护照

fields.label: 日期、航班时间及机场
fields.value: 2027 年 9 月 4 日（周六）抵达罗马，9 月 10 日（周五）从佛罗伦萨离开

fields.label: 预算和不含项目
fields.value: 两人约 2,400 欧元，不含国际机票

fields.label: 已有的酒店报价
fields.placeholder: 例如：罗马双人房每晚 140 欧元，邮件报价

zh.template: 请按{travellers}、{dates}、{budget}及{hotels}规划罗马和佛罗伦萨。合理安排预约景点、休息及一个托斯卡纳一日游。比较完整房费、税及官方火车；查票受阻和估算要写清，不编价格。按我的实际护照及日期核对入境要求，保留够用备用金。只做规划，不预订、不开户、不联系任何人、不付款。

phases.title: 核对官方景点价格、交通、城市税和入境规定，并查具体酒店
phases.note: 斗兽场、梵蒂冈、乌菲兹、大教堂、火车和锡耶纳一日游
phases.judgment: 酒店价格没有被当成报价：找到的六个价格都是 2026 年 11 月 6 日酒店官网上显示的价格，没有一家能确认 2027 年 9 月的房价，所以如实标明。

phases.title: 给住宿定价，做出一份六晚、加起来对得上的预算
phases.note: 房费、城市税、火车和一笔备用金
phases.judgment: 查税时纠正了预算里的数字：佛罗伦萨的 7 欧元住宿税针对四星酒店，三星是 6 欧元，和罗马一样。Trenitalia 官网打不开票价时，也没有编一个数：罗马到佛罗伦萨的火车按每人 50 欧元预留，并标明是估算。

phases.title: 写行程和来源清单，再请人独立检查
phases.note: 电脑和手机版式也检查过
phases.judgment: 一位同事独立重读了成稿，确认预算加得对（1,995.60 欧元加 404.40 欧元备用金，正好 2,400 欧元）。它还指出官方火车票价对比仍然缺失，计划里也如实写明；另外提醒有家酒店 23:00 后就不能办入住，晚到要提前安排。

workers: 查了六家具体酒店，每城三家，记录酒店自己网站上显示的价格
核对了罗马和佛罗伦萨的官方城市税、罗马到佛罗伦萨的火车方案，以及去锡耶纳的巴士
独立复核成稿，找夸大的说法、遗漏的要求和不现实的时间安排
